paragraphs: Those who decide before the Sages.
This occurs in Gittin 42b and Kiddushin 24b. Rashi explains: “It was not specified who they were.”[^1][^2]

notes.text: מב: and כד: give Gittin 42b and Kiddushin 24b under the colon convention, without independently checking named editions.

Rashi is the contextual commentator label in ופירש״י; Hyman reports him saying the identities were not specified. The plural deciding group remains unnamed, with no invented person or authority assignment.
